# MotoVault

> Free AI-powered motorcycle companion app for iOS and Android combining maintenance tracking, expense logging, GPS ride recording, multi-day trip planning with typed waypoints, and Claude-powered photo diagnostics — no OBD hardware required.

Last-Updated: 2026-06-01

## Key facts

- **What it is:** the only motorcycle app that combines maintenance tracking, expense logging, GPS ride recording, multi-day trip planning, AI photo diagnostics, and structured learning in one platform.
- **Platforms:** iOS and Android (free to download and use), plus a public route-discovery website at https://motovault.app/explore.
- **Price:** Free; optional MotoVault Pro is $4.99/month.
- **AI diagnostics:** powered by Anthropic's Claude — identifies a problem from a photo or plain-language symptom, with no OBD hardware required.
- **Motorcycle coverage:** all makes, models, and years via the official NHTSA vehicle database.
- **Languages:** English, German, French, Spanish, Italian.
- **Maker:** built by founder Andrej Kanuch.

## Core features

- [Trip Planning](https://motovault.app/features/trip-planning): Multi-day motorcycle routes with 11 typed waypoints, real road routing, rider RSVPs
- [AI Diagnostics](https://motovault.app/features/ai-diagnostics): Claude vision model, photo-based, no OBD hardware required
- [Garage Management](https://motovault.app/features/garage-management): Unlimited bikes, VIN decode, service intervals by mileage and time
- [Maintenance Tracking](https://motovault.app/features/maintenance): Service history, smart reminders by mileage and time, per-bike schedules
- [Expense Tracking](https://motovault.app/features/expense-tracking): Fuel, parts, and service by category, with cost-per-mile analytics
- [Ride Tracking](https://motovault.app/features/ride-tracking): GPS ride recording with speed and elevation profiles, linked to each bike
- [Learning Paths](https://motovault.app/features/learning-paths): Curated curriculum for first-year riders and beyond
